verdict.rationale: Lithic docs explicitly describe Card and Account Spend Limits for spend velocity control (lithic-docs-13), plus Authorization Rules v2 enforceable at program/account/card level using MCC, country, currency, risk score (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-17), with velocity and transaction-limit rule examples confirmed in the MCP server blog (lithic-docs-11), all enforced server-side without customer infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of separate daily/monthly/all-time window configuration options and per-cardholder (vs per-card/account) granularity distinctions, and independent hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
